Hello Rohan,

I hope you are having a great week. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal. I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself properly and see how GovSpring Legal can support Nava PBC as you continue this vital work for our veterans. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerk, who would also participate in any scheduled call.
